issue_request: FHIR-18432 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core XML change request from the STU3 ballot. It asked to remove the stale sentence saying common infrastructural elements were not shown in the XML representation because Resource and DomainResource content was now listed as comments at the top of the XML example.

That source change added the Resource comment to the XML example and replaced the rejected sentence with the current ordering statement.
additional_context: Current source/xml.html still contains the Resource comment and corrected infrastructural-element ordering wording, and the old XML-representation sentence is absent from that page. FHIR-18434 and FHIR-18435 were applied in the same historical commit but already have Issue-Reconcile-Key commits on the combined branch. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was needed because the current source already implements the requested correction.
